Prevention: Seed treatment using hot water (50°C/2mn) using clean, disease-free seeds.
Respect sowing dates: wet season starting 15
Practice crop rotation using different rice varieties.
Practice proper spacing between rows and within plants (20x20cm) to facilitate air circulation.
Weed control to remove host plants.
Nitrogen fertilizer two weeks after transplanting and 50kg/ha 60 days after transplanting.
Compost infected rice straws of previous season.
Monitoring: Regularly visit your crop, starting at nursery stage.
Observe the crop for the following symptoms:
Leaves: oval spots with grey or white centres and narrow brown borders.
If infection on the leaves is more than 5%, think on chemical control.
Direct Control: Apply 15g of tricyclazole 75% WP in 15 litres of water at nursery, tillering and booting stages
Restrictions: Wear protective equipment when applying pesticides.
